description: Create Friday (Jummah) greeting images in Turkish, English and Arabic from ready, reviewed messages.

interface.longDescription: Cuma Mesajı turns a ready, reviewed Friday greeting into a shareable image. Pick a message in Turkish, English or Arabic, choose one of three designs and either a square post or a vertical story size. The image is rendered on cumamesaji.com and comes back with WhatsApp and Facebook share links and a share page, so it can be sent to family and friends or saved for Instagram. Messages cannot be written freely, every greeting is prepared and reviewed in advance, and Arabic is laid out right to left.
